title: Packers will evaluate top draft prospects, even though their first pick is No. 52 overall

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers will evaluate top draft prospects, even though their first pick is No. 52 overall
sources.description: The Packers don't have a first-round pick, but that doesn't mean they won't be evaluating first-round prospects at the Scouting Combine.
